explanation: Encodes the conjecture of Ruzsa–Turjányi that |(A+A)∩[1,2N]| / A(N) → ∞, under the same hypotheses. The page reports this only as a conjecture. The formalization marks it solved, citing a Plünnecke–Ruzsa argument and a linked formal proof. The argument is sound: with B = A∩[0,N], hB covers [N₀, N], so (|B+B|/|B|)^h ≥ |hB|/|B| ≫ N/|B| → ∞, and B+B ⊆ [0,2N]. The page appears outdated on this point, but the statement itself is faithful.
